name: daw-pro
description: Claude Code plugins from the DAW Pro repo: the music-making agent team that drives the app over its MCP server, and a general-purpose narrated-video kit that has no dependency on the app at all.

plugins.name: daw-pro-music-team
plugins.description: A team of specialized agents and workflow skills that drive DAW Pro for real song creation and management, over its existing MCP server.

plugins.name: narrated-film
plugins.description: Turn screenshots, footage and audio into a finished narrated video entirely on your own machine: local cloned-voice TTS with a transcribe-back content gate, ffmpeg assembly, branded intro/end cards and channel art from a brand.json, and a verifier that checks the finished file with positive controls. No cloud service, no API key, and nothing specific to any one application.
